---
# Injected above the generated studyflow spec tables by scripts/build_spec.py.
---

This is the field reference for `studyflow.xml`, the machine-readable study *plan* at the root of a dataset: the elements a studyflow may contain—the study itself, activities such as cognitive tests, questionnaires, and instructions, the events and gateways that connect them, and the datasets they produce—and the fields each element carries. It is generated from the [studyflow schema](https://behaverse.org/schemas/studyflow) in `behaverse/schemas`.

For what a studyflow is and how the plan relates to the per-agent run log (`studyflow_log.csv`, defined by the trial family's [StudyflowLog](/spec/trial/01-studyflowlog.qmd) table), see [Studyflows](/spec/studyflows.qmd).
